audit_disposition: Audited — all pages are result-relevant supplementary content
extraction_basis: Visual verification of eFigure: PDF page 9; rendered artifact preprocessing/rendered_pages/page-009-9.png

evidence_map.reported_evidence: Lists eTables 1-5 and the eFigure; identifies the supplement as additional information for the randomized clinical trial.

evidence_map.content_type: secondary outcome / reintubation criteria and reasons
evidence_map.reported_evidence: Postextubation respiratory failure at day 7: 88/302 (29%) with high-flow nasal oxygen alone versus 70/339 (21%) with high-flow nasal oxygen with NIV; P=.02. Reintubation until ICU discharge: 59/302 (20%) versus 41/339 (12%); P=.009. The remaining rows give the component criteria for reintubation and reported reasons for reintubation by group.

evidence_map.location: PDF pp. 3-5, eTable 2, header; characteristics at admission; day-of-extubation characteristics; footnotes A-D
evidence_map.reported_evidence: Participants are split by baseline PaCO2: nonhypercapnic (≤45 mm Hg; high-flow alone n=254, high-flow with NIV n=276) and hypercapnic (>45 mm Hg; n=48 and n=63, respectively). The table reports admission, risk-factor, ventilator, spontaneous-breathing-trial, and pre-extubation characteristics with within-subgroup P values. Footnotes define SAPS II, SOFA, and simple/difficult/prolonged weaning.

evidence_map.location: PDF p. 6, eTable 3, Primary outcome and Secondary outcomes
evidence_map.reported_evidence: For hypercapnic patients (PaCO2 >45 mm Hg; n=48 high-flow alone; n=63 high-flow with NIV), reintubation at day 7 was 10/48 (21%) versus 5/63 (8%); absolute difference −12.9 percentage points (95% CI, −27.1 to −0.1); P=.0489. The table also reports respiratory failure, reintubation at 48 and 72 hours and until ICU discharge, ICU/hospital length of stay, and ICU/hospital/day-90 mortality outcomes.

evidence_map.location: PDF p. 7, eTable 4, Primary outcome and Secondary outcomes
evidence_map.reported_evidence: For nonhypercapnic patients (PaCO2 ≤45 mm Hg; n=254 high-flow alone; n=276 high-flow with NIV), reintubation at day 7 was 45/254 (18%) versus 35/276 (13%); absolute difference −5.0 percentage points (95% CI, −11.2 to 1.1); P=.1057. The table also reports respiratory failure, reintubation at 48 and 72 hours and until ICU discharge, ICU/hospital length of stay, and ICU/hospital/day-90 mortality outcomes.

evidence_map.location: PDF p. 8, eTable 5, Centers 1-30 and Total row
evidence_map.reported_evidence: Reports day-7 reintubation counts/rates for each of 30 centers overall and by randomized group. Total: 95/641 (15%) overall; 55/302 (18%) high-flow nasal oxygen alone; 40/339 (12%) high-flow nasal oxygen with NIV.

evidence_map.location: PDF p. 9, eFigure, Overall population panel; number-at-risk table
evidence_map.reported_evidence: Kaplan-Meier cumulative survival from extubation to day 90 in the overall population. The figure labels log-rank P=.37. Numbers at risk at days 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75, and 90 are 302, 284, 268, 260, 251, 242, 237 for high-flow nasal oxygen alone and 339, 314, 298, 286, 280, 280, 277 for high-flow nasal oxygen with NIV.
